title.en: Online Hydro-power Calculator: Electric 80 Concrete Pump keeps HBT80-16 prints 4 cm and below
title.zh: 在线 水力-功率 计算器：需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80保留「是 60 m³/h。」

description.en: Electric 80 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-80-concrete-pump. HBT80-16 prints 4 cm and below Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)
description.zh: 需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80见 /products/electric-80-concrete-pump。是 60 m³/h。此处使用的电动80列表上没有。

h1.en: Keep Electric 80 Concrete Pump under “Example - Hydro-power” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「示例 - 水力-功率」下保留需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 80 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-80-concrete-pump. HBT80-16 prints 4 cm and below. Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Not on the Electric 80 list used here. The site must be described against 110 kW. It prints conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m. The shipping note needs the Electric 80 weight if this is the path. The order must include the Electric 80 path when 900 m is the cell. Electric 60 uses the same 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm at 3300 kg and 90 kW. /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/, 110 kW, 900 m / 300 m, to /en/contact/. The model string HBT80-1816-110 also appears on HBT80-16, which prints 50 m³/h and 120 m horizontal conveying. If the distance you are matching is 900 m horizontal and 300 m vertical, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints that pair on Electric 80 only: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. The section title “Online Hydro-power Calculator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-80-concrete-pump。是 60 m³/h。此处使用的电动80列表上没有。现场情况要对照 110 kW 来写。HBT80-16 印 4 cm 及以下。电动80印 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。它印输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m。如果路径是电动80，运输说明要用电动80的重量。当 900 m 是你要的格子时，订单必须带电动80的路径。电动60使用相同的 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，但是 3300 kg、90 kW。型号字符串 HBT80-1816-110 也出现在 HBT80-16 上，那一页印 50 m³/h 和水平输送 120 m。/zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/、110 kW、900 m / 300 m，发到 /zh/contact/。如果你对照的距离是水平 900 m、垂直 300 m，河北品锦机械（邢台）只在电动80上印这一对：110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、川崎 140 双泵、6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。节标题「在线 水力-功率 计算器」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.zh: 在线 水力-功率 计算器

body.en: Under “Online Hydro-power Calculator”, Electric 80 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. HBT80-16 prints 4 cm and below. It prints conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m. /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/, 110 kW, 900 m / 300 m, to /en/contact/.
body.zh: 在「在线 水力-功率 计算器」下，需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80这一节只放已印出的格子。HBT80-16 印 4 cm 及以下。它印输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m。/zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/、110 kW、900 m / 300 m，发到 /zh/contact/。

body.en: “Example - Hydro-power” titles this part of the Electric 80 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). The shipping note needs the Electric 80 weight if this is the path. The model string HBT80-1816-110 also appears on HBT80-16, which prints 50 m³/h and 120 m horizontal conveying.
body.zh: 「示例 - 水力-功率」是需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。电动80印 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。型号字符串 HBT80-1816-110 也出现在 HBT80-16 上，那一页印 50 m³/h 和水平输送 120 m。如果你对照的距离是水平 900 m、垂直 300 m，河北品锦机械（邢台）只在电动80上印这一对：110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、川崎 140 双泵、6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。

body.en: For Electric 80 Concrete Pump, the heading “Efficiency” does not replace a cell. Not on the Electric 80 list used here. The order must include the Electric 80 path when 900 m is the cell. If the distance you are matching is 900 m horizontal and 300 m vertical, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints that pair on Electric 80 only: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg.
body.zh: 对需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80而言，标题「效率」并不替换任何格子。如果路径是电动80，运输说明要用电动80的重量。当 900 m 是你要的格子时，订单必须带电动80的路径。是 60 m³/h。

heading.zh: 能量 从 水力-功率

body.en: Electric 80 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Energy from Hydro-power”. The site must be described against 110 kW. Electric 60 uses the same 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm at 3300 kg and 90 kW. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydropower-d_1359.html.
body.zh: 需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80不因标题「能量 从 水力-功率」而改动。现场情况要对照 110 kW 来写。电动60使用相同的 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，但是 3300 kg、90 kW。此处使用的电动80列表上没有。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydropower-d_1359.html。

question.en: Does “Online Hydro-power Calculator” replace HBT80-16 prints 4 cm and below?
question.zh: 「在线 水力-功率 计算器」会替换「是 60 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 prints 4 cm and below remains the printed wording for Electric 80 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 60 m³/h。仍是需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm) belong on the Electric 80 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80这一行里，「此处使用的电动80列表上没有。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-80-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-80-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Example - Hydro-power” add to Electric 80 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「示例 - 水力-功率」给需要的格子是水平 900 m 时，订电动80增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydropower-d_1359.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hydropower-d_1359.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
